name: BRIJ Flight API
description: Flight API for paid flight search, escrow-backed booking intents, booking execution, refund requests, and Duffel order status lookup.
use_when: Use when the user wants to search flights, create a booking intent, book a flight, request a refund, or check flight order status.
how_to_call: If you are using BRIJ Wallet MCP, read openapi_url, build the target URL from x402.http_base_url plus the OpenAPI path, then call the BRIJ MCP tool call_paid_api_endpoint.

rules: Never invent offer_ids, intent_ids, prices, booking statuses, or support codes.
Only show data returned by the latest API response.
After each API call, parse the actual response before telling the user what happened.
Do not say a flight is booked until POST /air/intents/{intent_id}/book confirms success.
Do not restart search unless the current offer expired or the API says it is invalid.

steps.name: search
after_success: Show 3-5 best real offers from the response.
For each offer, show price, airline, departure time, arrival time, duration, and offer_id.
Tell the user offers expire quickly.
Ask the user to choose one offer_id before creating an intent.

steps.name: create_intent
after_success: Show intent_id, selected flight summary, escrow amount, expiry, and support code if present.
Say clearly that the flight is not booked yet.
Ask the user to confirm before calling the book endpoint.

steps.name: book
after_success: Say booked only if the API confirms booking or order success.
Show order_id, booking status, support code, and next steps if present.
after_error: If passenger data is invalid, fix only the invalid fields and retry only when safe.
If offer or intent expired, explain that a new search is required.
